purpose: Ensures the security program keeps pace with technical and environmental changes affecting ePHI.
summary: The covered entity or business associate performs periodic technical and non-technical evaluations, based initially on the standards implemented and subsequently in response to environmental or operational changes affecting ePHI, to determine whether existing security measures remain adequate.
expectedStatementElements: How often periodic evaluations are performed
What triggers an out-of-cycle evaluation (new systems, breaches, regulatory changes)
What is assessed during an evaluation (technical and non-technical safeguards)
Who performs the evaluation (internal team, external auditor)
How evaluation findings are tracked to remediation
evidenceExamples: Most recent security evaluation or risk assessment report
Evaluation schedule or policy defining cadence and triggers
Remediation tracking log tied to prior evaluation findings
Evidence of an evaluation triggered by a specific change (new system, incident)
commonGaps: Evaluation was performed once at initial implementation and never repeated
No defined trigger for evaluating after major environmental changes
Findings from past evaluations were never remediated or tracked
Evaluation only covers technical controls, ignoring policy and process gaps
interviewQuestions: When was the last security evaluation performed, and by whom?
What would trigger you to run an evaluation outside the normal schedule?
Can you show me findings from the last evaluation and their remediation status?
Does the evaluation cover non-technical safeguards, like policies and training?
